title: Seed round pitch
purpose: A first meeting with investors for an early stage company: hook, problem, solution, proof, market, competition, team, ask.

concept.idea: A calm, confident investor deck where one number per slide makes the case that clean energy is being thrown away
concept.avoid: Stock photos of wind farms, gradients, crowded bullet slides
concept.signature: Teal appears only on the one number or word that proves each slide

why: The first slide is a promise, the second is a surprising fact. The deck earns attention before it explains anything.
Every content headline is a full sentence that states the takeaway. The slide body only proves it.
The strongest proof (pilot results) comes before the market size. Traction beats promises.
No two neighbouring slides share a layout, and the accent tone is used once, for the ask.
The closing slide repeats the hook's subject (the megawatt) so the deck ends where it started.
Motion is subtle and identical on every slide: content rises, slides fade, and only the proof points count up. Nothing distracts from the argument.

motion.rationale: Seed investors judge clarity and judgment. Short rises and a quiet fade guide the eye without performing, the numbers are the only thing that moves on its own.

title: Enterprise sales deck
purpose: A first call with a buyer at a larger company: the cost of the problem, the solution, proof from a customer, how rollout works, pricing and one clear next step.

concept.idea: A sober buyer's document: the customer's own cost numbers, laid out with engineering order
concept.avoid: Marketing superlatives, hero images, playful shapes
concept.signature: Outline cards and one indigo number per slide

why: It opens with the buyer's problem and its cost in their numbers, not with the product.
The customer quote and the results chart come before pricing, so the price is read as a bargain.
The rollout timeline answers the unspoken question: how much effort will this be for us?
Pricing is a small table with one highlighted column, never a wall of features.
The ask is a single next step with a date, not a vague invitation.
The deck barely moves: fades only, so the buyer reads evidence instead of watching effects. The chart growing is the single motion that carries meaning.

motion.rationale: Enterprise buyers read for risk. Fades keep attention on the proof, counting numbers and growing charts carry the only motion.

slides.intent: Name the topic in the buyer's terms.

title: Product launch
purpose: Announcing a product to customers, press or partners: a bold hook, the three things it does, why it is different, early reactions, what comes next.

concept.idea: A warm, energetic launch that shows everyday life getting easier, one short line at a time
concept.avoid: Technical spec sheets and a dark corporate look
concept.signature: Short punchy headlines with one coral highlighted word

why: Short, energetic headlines. Nine slides is enough when every slide earns its place.
Features appear as three cards with a title and one sentence, never as a bullet list.
One big number carries the proof, and a customer voice carries the emotion.
The roadmap is short and honest: what ships now, what is next, what is later.
A brisk tempo and a rising entrance give it energy without adding decoration.
Slides push in from the right on every step, which turns the deck into forward motion. Brisk tempo keeps the energy without making anyone wait.

motion.rationale: A launch should feel like momentum: every slide pushes the story forward, content rises briskly, one hero moment per slide.

title: Quarterly board update
purpose: A board or investor update: results against plan, risks and the decisions needed. Professional and minimal, the deck does not move.
audience: Board of directors and existing investors

concept.idea: A board pack that gives the answer first and lets the numbers speak in plain, consistent order
concept.avoid: Animation, decorative color and slides without a stated message
concept.signature: Every headline is the finding with its number

why: The second slide gives the answer first: ahead on revenue, behind on hiring. The board knows the headline before any detail.
Every number is shown against plan, so the board judges progress, not raw figures.
Risks get their own slide in plain language. Boards trust decks that name problems.
It ends with the exact decisions and amounts needed, not a thank you.
Nothing moves: intensity still, no entrances, a quiet fade between slides, numbers shown at their final value. Stillness reads as confidence and keeps every second on the discussion.

motion.rationale: A board reads numbers and decides. Nothing moves, slides change with a quiet fade, so every second goes to the content and the discussion.

title: Consumer app launch
purpose: A launch event or keynote for a playful consumer brand: hook, how it works, proof, a reveal and the ask. Motion is part of the brand.

concept.idea: A playful, kinetic launch where the motion itself shows that learning together is more fun
concept.avoid: Static corporate slides and long text
concept.signature: One crimson word per headline that moves first

why: The hook is a surprising fact about the problem, landed with the one dramatic entrance of the deck.
The product is explained in three verbs on cards, then proven with one number and one real voice.
The price is held back for a reveal near the end, where the headline glides from the previous slide into place.
The deck writes its own motion vocabulary: a springy pop for content and a card like swipe between slides, both echoing how the app feels.
Two exceptions only (the hook and the reveal), so the custom motion stays a language and never turns into noise.

motion.rationale: Tandem is a playful app for people who learn together. The deck should feel like the app: springy, quick and a little cheeky, still one thing moving at a time.

pop.purpose: Content springs up into place, like a card in the app.

slam.purpose: The big claim lands from close to the viewer, once per deck.

swipe.purpose: Slides swipe like cards: the next one comes in with a slight tilt, the old one flies out.

glide.purpose: The headline glides into its new place while the slide around it fades in, for the reveal.
